narrative:
Overheads are GBP 326.1M in the FY2026 budget, planned by cost center and legal entity: Technology, Data & AI Platform about 26%, Bid, Sales & Account Management 26%, Group Functions 23%, Transformation & Cost-Out 16% and Property & Workplace 9%.

Headcount lines are driven from the workforce plan; non-headcount lines use drivers — bid pursuits, licences, leases and transformation milestones. Shared costs are allocated to divisions by FTE and handled minutes.

The transformation line carries the simplification programme behind the GBP 40M annualised savings target: GBP 8M was actioned by June.

signals.title: £40m simplification savings — £8m actioned
signals.excerpt: After the private sector contact centre disposal, actions taken by 30 June deliver £8m of annualised savings against a £40m target by end-2027, with about £20m cost to achieve.

signals.title: Snowflake chosen as the data layer of the AI Catalyst Stack
signals.excerpt: Multi-year agreement with Snowflake for data management and intelligence; Snowflake Select Partner status.
